services.name: Niagara Helicopters
services.desc: Niagara Helicopters sets extremely high standards in regards to pilot flying experience. We require approximately 2,000 hours in the air as pilot-in-command, most of which must be on the Bell 206L or 407 series helicopters. In fact, most of our pilots are well above this limit. There is good reason for our concern since Niagara Helicopters is world-renown as a professional sightseeing helicopter company. The skill, expertise and experience of our pilots, engineers and boarding crew are one of our most valuable marketing tools. services.name: Charter Flights
services.desc: If you are looking for one of the most unique experiences available in the Niagara Region, Niagara Helicopters will take you there. We offer a variety of specialty flights and charters throughout Southern Ontario. You can be whisked away for a romantic private tour over the Region, say “I do” directly over Niagara Falls, take a “man-cation” with friends for a fishing or hunting experience, arrive at the golf course like a true rock star - all by helicopter! blurb: Guests experience a scenic helicopter flight over Niagara Falls, seeing natural and man-made wonders from above. Flights offer views extending to Toronto and Lake Erie on clear days. The company has over 50 years of service with experienced pilots and customized helicopters featuring individual headsets with taped commentary.
